cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Resources shared by threads within a process
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify that threads share address space, code, data, heap, or open files.
acceptable_variants: threads share the same memory space
threads share process resources like file descriptors
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Shared by threads of one process: address space / code+data/heap / open files
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Threads in the same process typically share the process address space: code, data/heap, and open OS resources

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify that each thread has its own stack and register context/program counter.
acceptable_variants: each thread has a private stack
threads maintain their own execution state
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Per-thread private: stack and/or registers/PC/thread context.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Each thread has its own stack, register context / program counter, and thread-local scheduling state

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify that multithreading is lighter weight, faster to create/switch, or facilitates easier communication.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Advantage: lighter weight, faster create/switch, easy shared-memory communication
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: cheaper context switch / shared memory communication is easy

cqa_tuples.target_criteria: Identify that multithreading lacks isolation, risks memory corruption, or requires synchronization.
acceptable_variants: one thread can crash the process
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Disadvantage: weaker isolation / shared-memory bugs / need locks
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: one buggy thread can corrupt shared memory and crash the whole process; also needs synchronization
